item.title: Power Shutdown Alert: KPDCL to Suspend Supply in Pampore Areas
item.description: SRINAGAR, MARCH 02: Chief Engineer, Distribution, KPDCL has informed that the Shutdown of 33 KV Pampore-Lethpora line will be observed due to which power supply to Samboora, Lethpora, CRPF Lethpora, Ladhoo, Konibal, Chandhara, LIS and adjoining areas will be affected from 08 AM to 02 PM on 05 March 2026.
